info.name: Sana3y API - صنايعي
info.description:
Sana3y (صنايعي) - Platform connecting customers with local craftsmen/handymen for home services in Egypt.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require Bearer token authentication. After login, set the `token` variable or include in Authorization header.

## Phone Format
Egyptian phone: `+20XXXXXXXXXX`

## Base URL
- Development: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`
- Production: `https://api.sana3y.com/api/v1`
